quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
حمٓ
تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ۖ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ هَٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَٰرَةٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءًۭ وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ
وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًۭا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ قَدِيمٌۭ
وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًۭا وَرَحْمَةًۭ ۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌۭ مُّصَدِّقٌۭ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًۭا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًۭا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةًۭ قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

وَٱلَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
وَلِكُلٍّۢ دَرَجَٰتٌۭ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ

۞ وَٱذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُۥ بِٱلْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًۭا تَجْهَلُونَ
فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًۭا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا عَارِضٌۭ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ رِيحٌۭ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًۭا وَأَبْصَٰرًۭا وَأَفْـِٔدَةًۭ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَلَآ أَفْـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا۟ يَجْحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةًۢ ۖ بَلْ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنْهُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟ ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
يَٰقَوْمَنَآ أَجِيبُوا۟ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

فَٱصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعَزْمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ ۚ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةًۭ مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ ۚ بَلَٰغٌۭ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

parent_channels.name: P1 (46:1-14): Inscribed Truth Made Legible

subchannels.name: Joined marks become durable evidence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate marks are joined into an ordered inscription whose surviving trace can function as a landmark.
subchannels.active_motifs: Joined material (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); ordered written letters (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); a remaining trace (`quranic:root_000011:B003/m01`); a distinguishing landmark (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); a visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Scripture and requested evidence occupy one evidentiary scene: joined signs endure, distinguish a route, and remain available for inspection.

subchannels.name: Disclosure passes through witness, tongue, and messenger
subchannels.scene_or_process: Meaning becomes public through an articulate carrier and is then secured by present or knowledgeable testimony.
subchannels.active_motifs: A present witness (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`); declaration grounded in knowledge (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); meaning disclosed by word or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); clear articulation (`quranic:root_000996:B001/m01`); the tongue as language and message (`quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `كفى به شهيدا بيني وبينكم` (46:8), `شاهد من بني إسرائيل` (46:10), `بلسان عربي` (46:12), and `ينذر` (46:12).
subchannels.synthesis: The truth claim is not only a text-object; it is voiced in a legible tongue and enters a field of accountable witnessing.

subchannels.name: Precedence is tested by traceable following
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marked predecessor opens a path, later travelers follow it, and rival claims of precedence become visible as movement on that path.
subchannels.active_motifs: Following or imitation (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); successive following (`quranic:root_000186:B001/m01`); gentle route guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); a forward race (`quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `تتلى عليهم آياتنا` (46:7), `أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي` (46:9), `سبقونا إليه` and `يهتدوا به` (46:11), and `من قبله كتاب موسى إماما` (46:12).
subchannels.synthesis: Moses' book, present revelation, and human response form a procession rather than isolated assertions; the issue is who follows an attested route and who merely claims to be ahead.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A true communication leaves ordered, transmissible marks that can be read, witnessed, and followed.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the book and its signs are presented as evidence in 46:2, 46:4, 46:7-10, and 46:12.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The branch images turn abstract proof into a material chain of stitching, inscription, landmarks, testimony, and tracked passage.

parent_channels.name: P1 (46:1-14): Claims Tested by Response

subchannels.name: The invocation circuit remains open
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call is projected toward an absent target, but no answering movement returns and the target remains inattentive.
subchannels.active_motifs: Calling or attraction by speech (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); a reply that meets a call (`quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`); inattentive lapse (`quranic:root_001097:B001/m01`); a lost or vanished object (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); claimed partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `تدعون من دون الله` (46:4), `من يدعو من دون الله` and `لا يستجيب له` (46:5), `عن دعائهم غافلون` (46:5), and `لهم شرك` (46:4).
subchannels.synthesis: Nonresponse is not incidental silence; it diagnoses the invoked relation as lost, inattentive, and incapable of completing the claim of partnership.

subchannels.name: Gathering converts objects of worship into adversaries
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human claimants and invoked figures are driven into one assembly, where presumed service and alliance reverse into hostility and disavowal.
subchannels.active_motifs: Driven gathering (`quranic:root_000324:B001/m01`); an enemy or adversary (`quranic:root_000993:B003/m01`); worship as obedience (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); explicit disavowal (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); human visibility against hiddenness (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `إذا حشر الناس` (46:6), `كانوا لهم أعداء` (46:6), and `كانوا بعبادتهم كافرين` (46:6).
subchannels.synthesis: Assembly makes the failed relation visible: what had been treated as obedient access is disclosed as mutual opposition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A claimed relation is exposed by whether a call completes a response circuit and whether the claimed party remains allied under assembly.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 46:4-6 tests invocation by response, awareness, gathering, and the final posture of the invoked beings.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The latent imagery recasts theology as a failed communication system followed by a public reversal of roles.

parent_channels.name: P1 (46:1-14): Counterfeit Craft and Capture

subchannels.name: Fabrication behaves like patched material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pieces are cut, joined, and presented as though the resulting artifact had an integral origin.
subchannels.active_motifs: Hide cut for repair or stitching (`quranic:root_001150:B001/m01`); a destructive split (`quranic:root_001150:B002/m01`); a fabricated lie (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`); invented speech (`quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`); a made-up artifact (`quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `افتراه` and `افتريته` (46:8), `بدعا من الرسل` (46:9), `إفك قديم` (46:11), and `خلق السماوات والأرض` (46:3).
subchannels.synthesis: The accusation of invention is pressured by its own branch field: fabrication is a secondary craft of cutting and joining, unlike the originating act named nearby.

subchannels.name: Denial works by covering and redirecting sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: An encountered disclosure is covered, turned aside, or made to appear in a displaced direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: Directional reversal (`quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`); magic as perceptual diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`); physical covering (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); blockage of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); turning one's side away (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `سحر مبين` (46:7), `كفرتم به` (46:10), `إفك قديم` (46:11), and `وهم عما أنذروا معرضون` (46:3).
subchannels.synthesis: The opponents' labels describe a distortion in the message, while the branch pattern relocates the distortion into their own acts of covering and directional refusal.

subchannels.name: Rival claims become a hunting scene
subchannels.scene_or_process: A decoy relation is set, tracks are demanded, and perception is diverted before the quarry can follow a reliable trace.
subchannels.active_motifs: A hunter's snare (`quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`); a hoof mark used for tracking (`quranic:root_000011:B008/m01`); deceptive diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `لهم شرك في السماوات` and `ائتوني ... أثارة من علم` (46:4), and `هذا سحر مبين` (46:7).
subchannels.synthesis: The demand for evidence tests whether the alleged partnership leaves a real track; without one, the claim operates more like a snare coupled to misdirection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Falsehood is manufactured by joining or covering material, then maintained by redirecting perception and trapping inquiry.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; accusations of magic and fabrication, together with the charge of old falsehood, dominate 46:7-11.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lexical branches materialize polemical labels as workshop operations and hunting techniques.

parent_channels.name: P1 (46:1-14): Measured Structure and Lasting Shelter

subchannels.name: Creation is fitted workmanship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material is measured, joined across an interval, and fixed into a coherent upper and lower structure.
subchannels.active_motifs: Measuring before cutting (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); originating or creating (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); an overhead canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); lower ground (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); a fitting joint or socket (`quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إلا بالحق` (46:3) and `العزيز الحكيم` (46:2).
subchannels.synthesis: `بالحق` reads not only as truth or purpose but as proper fit: measured parts form a structure whose intervals and boundaries are not arbitrary.

subchannels.name: Uprightness settles into protected enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travelers hold an upright line through rough ground and arrive as protected companions in an enclosed, enduring place.
subchannels.active_motifs: Uprightness (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); rough terrain (`quranic:root_000317:B002/m01`); expected fear (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`); protected companionship (`quranic:root_000844:B002/m01`); an enclosed garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ثم استقاموا` and `فلا خوف عليهم` (46:13), and `أصحاب الجنة هم فيها خالدون` (46:14).
subchannels.synthesis: Moral constancy is rendered as maintained alignment across difficult terrain, with the garden functioning as the protected enclosure appropriate to that alignment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Fitted order at the scale of creation corresponds to upright placement at the human scale and culminates in stable residence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 46:3 names purposeful cosmic construction, while 46:13-14 names uprightness and enduring garden residence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Workshop, terrain, and enclosure branches make cosmology and moral steadiness parts of one architecture of inhabitable order.

parent_channels.name: P1 (46:1-14): Descent as Provisioned Arrival

subchannels.name: Incoming proof follows a channel and gathers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something called for comes from elsewhere, enters a channel or hollow, and can overflow into the receiving field.
subchannels.active_motifs: A water channel (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); a flood arriving from elsewhere (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); a water hollow or basin (`quranic:root_000281:B003/m01`); overflow and spreading (`quranic:root_001192:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ائتوني بكتاب` (46:4), `الحق لما جاءهم` (46:7), and `إذ تفيضون فيه` (46:8).
subchannels.synthesis: The requested proof and the arrived truth are reframed as incoming flow: the issue is whether the receiving basin contains and examines it or lets discourse spill around it.

subchannels.name: Descent is a prepared lodging
subchannels.scene_or_process: An arriving communication is brought down, made present, and furnished like a ration or lodging prepared for a guest.
subchannels.active_motifs: Descent or arrival (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); a delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); a prepared guest ration (`quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`); arrival from elsewhere (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `تنزيل الكتاب` (46:2) and `ائتوني بكتاب من قبل هذا` (46:4).
subchannels.synthesis: Revelation's descent is not bare vertical motion; it is an arrival furnished for reception, which sharpens the contrast with a demand that refuses the provision already present.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What comes from beyond the immediate scene arrives through a route and is received either as evidence or as prepared provision.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; `تنزيل` in 46:2 and imperatives or events of coming in 46:4 and 46:7 supply the surface movement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Watercourse and hospitality branches give revelation's arrival hydraulic and residential dimensions.

parent_channels.name: P2 (46:15-25): Generational Formation Under Load

subchannels.name: Formation is carried and laid down
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mother bears increasing weight under hardship until the carried body is released in birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: Pregnancy or fruit carried within (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m01`); a burden borne with hardship (`quranic:root_000357:B007/m01`); carried difficulty (`quranic:root_001295:B002/m01`); birth as laying down (`quranic:root_001657:B002/m01`); the event of birth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `حملته أمه كرها ووضعته كرها` and `حمله` (46:15).
subchannels.synthesis: The paired verbs make kinship inseparable from embodied load: formation is a costly transfer from internal carrying to external placement.

subchannels.name: Separation opens a measured path to strength
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dependence is gradually cut, the child reaches successive thresholds, and mature agency emerges at a measured term.
subchannels.active_motifs: A weaned offspring (`quranic:root_001159:B003/m01`); mature strength (`quranic:root_000782:B004/m01`); reaching an endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); the measure four (`quranic:root_000536:B001/m01`); a month as a measured interval (`quranic:root_000823:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `فصاله ثلاثون شهرا`, `حتى إذا بلغ أشده`, and `بلغ أربعين سنة` (46:15).
subchannels.synthesis: Weaning and maturity are not abrupt states but calibrated separations, preparing the adult to answer inherited care with deliberate action.

subchannels.name: Numerical and moral terms open into a pastoral nursery
subchannels.scene_or_process: The verse's numbers, gratitude, and blessing activate an animal-rearing landscape of udders, milk, livestock, and seasonal pasture.
subchannels.active_motifs: A three-uddered camel (`quranic:root_000203:B005/m01`); an udder filled with milk (`quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`); livestock as wealth (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); spring pasture (`quranic:root_000536:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ثلاثون شهرا`, `أربعين سنة`, `أشكر نعمتك`, and `أنعمت علي` (46:15).
subchannels.synthesis: The latent pastoral field does not replace the human family scene; it materializes nourishment, growth, and counted maturation as conditions behind gratitude.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A new generation is formed through carried weight, painful release, staged separation, and eventual maturity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 46:15 explicitly sequences pregnancy, birth, weaning, full strength, and forty years.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pastoral branch senses place the human chronology inside a material economy of udders, livestock, carrying age, and spring growth.

parent_channels.name: P2 (46:15-25): Ordered Repair and Accepted Settlement

subchannels.name: Gratitude becomes commissioned repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: A beneficiary is restrained toward a task, recognizes the benefit, and asks to make both present work and future lineage sound.
subchannels.active_motifs: Ordered restraint or commission (`quranic:root_001644:B001/m01`); gratitude (`quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`); bounty or well-being (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`); repair and sound action (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`); safety and soundness (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `وصينا الإنسان`, `أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك`, `أعمل صالحا`, `أصلح لي في ذريتي`, and `من المسلمين` (46:15).
subchannels.synthesis: Gratitude is not an interior sentiment alone; it becomes a commissioned repair extending backward to parents, outward to work, and forward to descendants.

subchannels.name: Review selects the best and passes over harm
subchannels.scene_or_process: A record is received, its best actions are accepted, and damaging entries are crossed without being made determinative.
subchannels.active_motifs: Acceptance or reception (`quranic:root_001198:B004/m01`); passing over (`quranic:root_000276:B004/m01`); a beneficent act (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`); intentional work (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); a harmful deed (`quranic:root_000755:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `نتقبل عنهم أحسن ما عملوا` and `نتجاوز عن سيئاتهم` (46:16).
subchannels.synthesis: Acceptance and pardon are complementary review operations: good work is positively received while faults are traversed rather than allowed to block the promised destination.

subchannels.name: Every rank receives a full settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinct levels are assigned according to work, then each account is completed without withheld value.
subchannels.active_motifs: Stages or ranks (`quranic:root_000468:B003/m01`); fullness without deficit (`quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`); a worker's wage (`quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`); withholding another's right (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ولكل درجات مما عملوا`, `ليوفيهم أعمالهم`, and `وهم لا يظلمون` (46:19).
subchannels.synthesis: Difference in rank does not imply arbitrariness; the branch field frames judgment as exact labor settlement with no missing share.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Received care generates an obligation to repair, after which deeds are assessed, accepted, passed over, and fully settled.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the prayer for grateful right action in 46:15 leads to acceptance and pardon in 46:16 and graded repayment in 46:19.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Administrative and transactional branches turn piety into an ordered process of repair, review, and non-deficient settlement.

parent_channels.name: P2 (46:15-25): Inherited Promise and Generational Rupture

subchannels.name: The household relay breaks at the promise
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parents transmit a promised emergence, the child rejects it with a sound of disgust, and their urgent appeal fails to establish belief.
subchannels.active_motifs: A sound of disgust (`quranic:root_000039:B001/m01`); parents and generative origin (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); a binding promise (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); emergence or exiting (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); aid sought under distress (`quranic:root_001111:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `قال لوالديه أف لكما`, `أتعدانني أن أخرج`, `وهما يستغيثان الله`, and `آمن إن وعد الله حق` (46:17).
subchannels.synthesis: The conflict is not simply young against old; it is a failed transmission from generative care to promised regeneration.

subchannels.name: Private refusal is incorporated into passing communities
subchannels.scene_or_process: One resistant household is entered into a sequence of prior communities whose completed passage has already fixed the loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: Communities or nations (`quranic:root_000053:B004/m01`); hidden beings (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`); visible humans (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`); a deserved and binding verdict (`quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`); general loss (`quranic:root_000409:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `في أمم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والإنس` and `إنهم كانوا خاسرين` (46:18), with `قد خلت القرون من قبلي` (46:17).
subchannels.synthesis: The son's appeal to vanished generations is reversed: those generations are not evidence against the promise but the historical body into which his refusal is placed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A household transmission fails when inherited warning is dismissed as exhausted ancestry, and that local refusal enters a transgenerational verdict.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 46:17 stages the parent-child dispute, and 46:18 places it among prior human and jinn communities.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The branches make the scene a broken relay in which birth, emergence, succession, distress, and archival memory no longer align.

parent_channels.name: P2 (46:15-25): Promised Arrival, Rain Expectation, and Stripping Wind

subchannels.name: The demanded event exceeds the messenger's custody
subchannels.scene_or_process: A people demand immediate delivery, while the messenger restricts his role to transmitting notice and locates knowledge of timing elsewhere.
subchannels.active_motifs: Coming into a scene (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`); arrival from elsewhere (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); a threat or promised event (`quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`); delivery of a message (`quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`); dispatch of an envoy (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); premature haste (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `فأتنا بما تعدنا` (46:22), `إنما العلم عند الله وأبلغكم ما أرسلت به` (46:23), and `ما استعجلتم به` (46:24).
subchannels.synthesis: The demand conflates messenger, message, timing, and event; the reply separates them before the event itself arrives.

subchannels.name: The horizon offers a rain-shaped appearance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mass faces the valleys from the horizon and is classified by its observers as an incoming rain cloud.
subchannels.active_motifs: A horizon cloud (`quranic:root_001001:B003/m01`); a facing approach (`quranic:root_001198:B001/m01`); a valley as runoff route (`quranic:root_001637:B005/m01`); rain (`quranic:root_001431:B001/m01`); requesting rain or good (`quranic:root_001431:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `فلما رأوه عارضا مستقبل أوديتهم قالوا هذا عارض ممطرنا` (46:24).
subchannels.synthesis: Every visible feature supports an agricultural reading, so the error lies not in seeing an arrival but in assigning benefit to its form.

subchannels.name: Expected rain activates an irrigation assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: Incoming water is imagined as entering channels, filling containers, and being presented at mouths for use.
subchannels.active_motifs: A watercourse (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); a flood entering from elsewhere (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); filling a waterskin (`quranic:root_001431:B009/m01`); watering at the mouths of camels (`quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `فأتنا` (46:22), `عارضا مستقبل أوديتهم`, and `ممطرنا` (46:24).
subchannels.synthesis: The latent irrigation scene explains the speed of hopeful recognition: the approaching mass is mentally routed into channels of sustenance before its force is known.

subchannels.name: The arriving medium reverses from water to hostile air
subchannels.scene_or_process: The expected carrier of water discloses itself as contrary-moving air whose force bears pain rather than fertility.
subchannels.active_motifs: Contrary winds (`quranic:root_000041:B004/m01`); wind or moving air (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`); wind as force (`quranic:root_000609:B011/m01`); punitive rain (`quranic:root_001431:B002/m01`); inflicted pain (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `لتأفكنا عن آلهتنا` (46:22) and `بل هو ما استعجلتم به ريح فيها عذاب أليم` (46:24).
subchannels.synthesis: The scene pivots within the same atmospheric expectation: what looked water-bearing becomes an air-force carrying the opposite yield.

subchannels.name: Destruction harvests the inhabited field
subchannels.scene_or_process: A totalizing force cuts through what had been settled until only empty dwellings remain available to sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: Annihilation (`quranic:root_000487:B002/m01`); cutting or harvesting (`quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`); totality (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); transition into a new state (`quranic:root_000839:B010/m01`); settled dwellings (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `تدمر كل شيء بأمر ربها`, `فأصبحوا لا يرى إلا مساكنهم`, and `نجزي القوم المجرمين` (46:25).
subchannels.synthesis: The wind behaves like a negative harvest: it removes the inhabitants and leaves the built husks as the only visible crop.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An demanded arrival is first misrecognized as benefit, then discloses its contrary force and removes the settled world that expected to receive it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 46:21-25 moves from warning and impatient demand to horizon cloud, expected rain, punitive wind, and emptied dwellings.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hydrological, irrigation, wind-force, and harvest branches slow the scene into distinct stages of approach, intake, reversal, and stripping.

parent_channels.name: P2 (46:15-25): Temporary Stock and Status Reversal

subchannels.name: Worldly goods are a consumed allotment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A stock of desirable goods is taken out, used for immediate benefit, and found absent when the longer account opens.
subchannels.active_motifs: Good or pure stock (`quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`); enjoyed utility (`quranic:root_001395:B001/m01`); provisions serving needs (`quranic:root_001395:B003/m01`); something gone or passed (`quranic:root_000522:B006/m01`); a temporary commodity or share (`quranic:root_001001:B008/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `أذهبتم طيباتكم في حياتكم الدنيا واستمتعتم بها` (46:20).
subchannels.synthesis: The rebuke concerns allocation as much as pleasure: valuable stock was fully spent inside the nearest horizon and cannot answer the later claim.

subchannels.name: Public exposure turns elevation into abasement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Those who enlarged themselves are presented openly, stripped of protective casing, and assigned a lowered status.
subchannels.active_motifs: Public display (`quranic:root_001001:B002/m01`); fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); arrogance or self-enlargement (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`); humiliation (`quranic:root_001608:B003/m01`); breaking out of a husk (`quranic:root_001156:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `يوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار`, `عذاب الهون`, `تستكبرون في الأرض`, and `تفسقون` (46:20).
subchannels.synthesis: Exposure reverses the pursued vertical order: self-elevation on earth ends in a humiliating removal of cover before the fire.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Goods and elevated status consumed without truth are exhausted before public judgment, where height reverses into abasement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 46:20 contrasts spent worldly goods and enjoyment with exposure to fire, humiliation, arrogance, and transgression.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Commodity, husk, and vertical-status branches turn the judgment into an inventory and stripping operation.

parent_channels.name: P3 (46:26-35): Reception Becomes Relay

subchannels.name: Perceptual faculties are installed instruments
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community is given capacity and equipped with hearing, vision, and inward apprehension.
subchannels.active_motifs: Empowered capacity (`quranic:root_001439:B005/m01`); making or equipping (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); hearing (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); eyesight (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); inward insight (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); the heart as inner heat (`quranic:root_001122:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `مكناهم`, `وجعلنا لهم سمعا وأبصارا وأفئدة` (46:26).
subchannels.synthesis: The faculties are presented as furnished capacities, so their failure cannot be attributed to missing equipment.

subchannels.name: Conscious refusal disables otherwise intact equipment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Installed faculties remain present but yield no protective benefit because encountered signs are knowingly denied and mocked.
subchannels.active_motifs: Failure to suffice or benefit (`quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`); denial despite knowledge (`quranic:root_000224:B001/m01`); ridicule (`quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`); a consequence encircling its target (`quranic:root_000381:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `فما أغنى عنهم سمعهم ولا أبصارهم ولا أفئدتهم من شيء`, `إذ كانوا يجحدون بآيات الله`, and `ما كانوا به يستهزئون` (46:26).
subchannels.synthesis: The failure is functional and moral, not anatomical: refusal turns complete perceptual equipment into an unprofitable apparatus.

subchannels.name: Listening requires an ordered assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A small group is directed into presence, attends a recitation in silence, and waits until the communication reaches completion.
subchannels.active_motifs: A hidden company (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`); a small mobilized group (`quranic:root_001532:B003/m01`); attentive silence (`quranic:root_001508:B001/m01`); recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); presence at an event (`quranic:root_000333:B001/m01`); completion (`quranic:root_001237:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `صرفنا إليك نفرا من الجن يستمعون القرآن`, `فلما حضروه قالوا أنصتوا`, and `فلما قضي` (46:29).
subchannels.synthesis: Successful reception has an order: arrival, presence, mutual regulation, sustained attention, and completion precede interpretation or action.

subchannels.name: Hearers turn back as warning carriers
subchannels.scene_or_process: The completed audience reverses direction, returns to its own community, and converts received speech into warning.
subchannels.active_motifs: Redirecting or turning (`quranic:root_000860:B001/m01`); turning back (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`); a people or community (`quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`); alarm or warning (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ولوا إلى قومهم منذرين` (46:29) and `قالوا يا قومنا` (46:30-31).
subchannels.synthesis: Listening completes itself in relay: the group does not retain the event as private experience but reverses course to reproduce its warning function.

subchannels.name: The heard book lays out a straight route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A descended writing confirms what lies before it and extends a navigable line toward truth.
subchannels.active_motifs: Ordered written letters (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); a delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); confirmation enacted (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); what lies in front (`quranic:root_001693:B008/m01`); guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); an extended road (`quranic:root_000932:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `سمعنا كتابا أنزل من بعد موسى مصدقا لما بين يديه يهدي إلى الحق وإلى طريق مستقيم` (46:30).
subchannels.synthesis: The book is received as route-making continuity: descent, confirmation, and guidance align prior disclosure with forward travel.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sensory capacity becomes meaningful only when hearing is disciplined into recognition, response, and renewed warning.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; failed hearing, sight, and hearts in 46:26 contrast with the jinn's listening, understanding, and return to their people in 46:29-31.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Instrument, assembly, completion, and route branches show reception as a multi-stage relay rather than passive exposure.

parent_channels.name: P3 (46:26-35): Proximity and Protection Put to Test

subchannels.name: Manufactured proximity cannot produce help
subchannels.scene_or_process: Objects are adopted and offered as means of nearness, but disappear precisely when assistance is required.
subchannels.active_motifs: Acquiring or adopting (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); an offering that establishes proximity (`quranic:root_001212:B005/m01`); an object of worship (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); assistance (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`); something lost or vanished (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); fabricated falsehood (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `اتخذوا من دون الله قربانا آلهة`, `فلولا نصرهم`, `بل ضلوا عنهم`, and `ذلك إفكهم وما كانوا يفترون` (46:28).
subchannels.synthesis: Sacral proximity is judged by performance under need; disappearance at the point of aid exposes both the adopted objects and the fabrication that sustained them.

subchannels.name: Response determines whether pursuit can be escaped
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call demands an answer; refusal leaves the hearer unable to outstrip pursuit and without an alternate ally.
subchannels.active_motifs: Answering a call (`quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`); calling or attraction by speech (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); escaping or outstripping a pursuer (`quranic:root_000985:B002/m01`); an ally who gives help (`quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`); straying from the route (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `أجيبوا داعي الله` (46:31), `ومن لا يجب داعي الله فليس بمعجز في الأرض`, `وليس له من دونه أولياء`, and `في ضلال مبين` (46:32).
subchannels.synthesis: Answering is a protection decision: refusal does not preserve autonomy but leaves the nonrespondent exposed to a pursuit no other patron can block.

subchannels.name: True protection covers fault and grants asylum
subchannels.scene_or_process: Belief establishes a protected relation in which offenses are covered and the exposed person is brought into shelter from pain.
subchannels.active_motifs: Settled belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); covering the effect of wrongdoing (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); an offense or sin (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); neighborhood asylum (`quranic:root_000275:B003/m01`); painful punishment (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `وآمنوا به يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويجركم من عذاب أليم` (46:31).
subchannels.synthesis: Forgiveness and rescue are one sheltering operation: the past breach is covered while the person is conducted out of the threatened consequence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Claimed nearness is valid only if it can answer, assist, cover fault, and secure escape under pressure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; false proximity and failed gods in 46:28 are contrasted with answering God's caller, forgiveness, rescue, and the absence of other protectors in 46:31-32.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Offering, neighborhood asylum, pursuit, and covering branches translate religious relation into enforceable protection.

parent_channels.name: P3 (46:26-35): Measured Power, Origination, and Restoration

subchannels.name: The cosmic workshop does not exhaust its maker
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vast upper and lower structure is measured, designed, and produced without dulling the agent's capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: Measuring before making (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); originating or creating (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); design and calculation (`quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`); effective capacity (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`); an overhead canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); bodily fatigue (`quranic:root_001070:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض ولم يعي بخلقهن بقادر` (46:33).
subchannels.synthesis: The verse's inference rests on surplus capacity: completed cosmic workmanship has not depleted the power that produced it.

subchannels.name: Lost life can be reactivated
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life that has ceased is restored as one further exercise of the same undiminished capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: Earth revived by rain (`quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`); a living creature or spirit (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); loss of life (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); restoring or preserving life (`quranic:root_000383:B006/m01`); effective capacity (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`); an entire class or totality (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `أن يحيي الموتى بلى إنه على كل شيء قدير` (46:33).
subchannels.synthesis: Revival is not introduced as a disconnected marvel; it is the renewed activation of life by a capacity already shown to remain intact after creation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Power is demonstrated by measured origination without exhaustion and by the capacity to return lost life.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 46:33 argues from creation of the heavens and earth without fatigue to the revival of the dead.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Workshop calculation and bodily fatigue branches make the argument a comparison between complete fabrication and unspent productive capacity.

parent_channels.name: P3 (46:26-35): Temporal Discipline at the Promised Limit

subchannels.name: Resolve binds the messenger to a fixed course
subchannels.scene_or_process: The self is restrained, the heart is tied to a decision, and the messenger rises to remain on the assigned route.
subchannels.active_motifs: Restraining oneself (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); binding the heart in resolve (`quranic:root_001010:B001/m01`); a fixed course (`quranic:root_001010:B004/m01`); deliberate action (`quranic:root_000563:B004/m01`); rising to a task (`quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `فاصبر كما صبر أولو العزم من الرسل` (46:35).
subchannels.synthesis: Patience is active route-keeping: resolve fixes the heart so the messenger does not abandon or accelerate the commissioned course.

subchannels.name: Haste collapses before experienced duration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A shortcut is demanded, but when the appointed event is seen, the preceding interval contracts to a brief daylight stay.
subchannels.active_motifs: Premature haste (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); a shortcut or rapid path (`quranic:root_000987:B008/m01`); lingering or staying (`quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`); a measured duration (`quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`); the opening span of daylight (`quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`); an appointed time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ولا تستعجل لهم`, `يوم يرون ما يوعدون`, and `كأنهم لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من نهار` (46:35).
subchannels.synthesis: The demanded acceleration is undercut by retrospective compression: once the promise is present, the allegedly long delay appears as only a fragment of daylight.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A fixed outcome requires resolved endurance from the messenger and exposes human estimates of delay as radically compressed.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 46:35 joins patience, resolute messengers, prohibition of haste, the promised sight, a brief day-span, delivery, and destruction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Heart-binding, shortcut, lodging-time, and daylight branches make patience a disciplined relation to route and duration.

parent_channels.name: S1. P3 (46:26-35): Signs Recirculated Around Settlements
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Nearby settlements form a ring of examples through which signs are repeatedly turned so observers may reverse course and return.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Surrounding proximity (`quranic:root_000373:B004/m01`); a village as gathered settlement (`quranic:root_001222:B001/m01`); a village as basin or vessel (`quranic:root_001222:B004/m01`); changing the face or direction of signs (`quranic:root_000860:B002/m01`); return (`quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`); following settlements or their routes (`quranic:root_001222:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `أهلكنا ما حولكم من القرى وصرفنا الآيات لعلهم يرجعون` (46:27).
parent_channels.synthesis: The destroyed towns are not inert ruins; arranged around the addressees, they become vessels that recirculate signs and invite a directional return.

parent_channels.name: S2. P3 (46:26-35): Fire-Side Assay
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Deniers are presented at the fire, compelled to identify reality, and then made to test bodily what they had blocked conceptually.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Presentation for sight (`quranic:root_001001:B002/m01`); fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); negation (`quranic:root_001390:B001/m01`); truth or established reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); tasting (`quranic:root_000526:B001/m01`); experiential testing (`quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`); blockage of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `يوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار`, `أليس هذا بالحق`, `قالوا بلى وربنا`, and `فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون` (46:34).
parent_channels.synthesis: The exchange moves from visual presentation to verbal admission to embodied assay; denied truth becomes an experienced object rather than a proposition held at distance.

parent_channels.name: S3. Whole-surah: Hearth, Pot, and Inverted Hospitality
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A third hearthstone completes the support for a cooking pot, fire roasts and bakes its contents, a protective cloth lowers the hot vessel, and gathered food is set before a guest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: A third hearthstone (`quranic:root_000203:B007/m01`); a cooking pot and its cookery (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`); roasting and baking fire (`quranic:root_001122:B001/m01`); a cloth used to lower the pot (`quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`); food gathered for a guest (`quranic:root_001222:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `ثلاثون` (46:15), `أذهبتم طيباتكم في حياتكم الدنيا واستمتعتم بها` (46:20), `جعلنا` and `أفئدتهم` (46:26), `القرى` (46:27), `بقادر` and `قدير` (46:33), and `يعرض الذين كفروا على النار` and `فذوقوا العذاب` (46:34).
parent_channels.synthesis: By supplying hearth, pot, heat, handler, and guest serving, the cluster materializes the surah's primary consumption reversal: self-directed enjoyment of good things in 46:20 gives way to compulsory tasting at the fire in 46:34. It reframes judgment as inverted hospitality, turning chosen consumption into imposed reception without treating the punished as food.

parent_channels.name: S4. P1 -> P2 -> P3, role-reversal bridge: The Accusation Returns
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A diverted judgment produces a lie, projects diversion onto a messenger, and is finally identified as the claimants' own fabrication; the intervening rain expectation undergoes the same reversal.
parent_channels.active_motifs: A lie diverted from truth (`quranic:root_000041:B002/m01`); a diverted mind or stratagem (`quranic:root_000041:B006/m01`); land from which rain has been turned away (`quranic:root_000041:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `هذا إفك قديم` (P1, 46:11), `لتأفكنا عن آلهتنا` (P2, 46:22), `عارض ممطرنا` and `بل هو ... ريح فيها عذاب أليم` (P2, 46:24), and `ذلك إفكهم وما كانوا يفترون` (P3, 46:28).
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is a role reversal across P1, P2, and P3: `إفك` begins as an accusation attached to revelation, becomes an alleged operation of the messenger, and returns as the verdict on the accusers' own religious manufacture. The rain-deprived-land motif materializes the reversal inside P2, where an arrival classified as rain yields the contrary result.

parent_channels.name: S5. P1 -> P2 -> P3, spatial role-reversal bridge: From Turning Aside to Exposure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An agent presents its side and takes a crosswise orientation; a lateral object then meets the observers' sight, and those observers are themselves set out as objects of view.
parent_channels.active_motifs: The side or breadth of a thing (`quranic:root_001001:B001/m01`); an obstruction or encounter across a path (`quranic:root_001001:B004/m01`); something set up and exposed (`quranic:root_001001:B011/m01`); a crosswise course resistant to straight movement (`quranic:root_001001:B012/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `وهم عما أنذروا معرضون` (P1, 46:3), `يوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار` (P2, 46:20), `فلما رأوه عارضا` (P2, 46:24), and `يوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار` (P3, 46:34).
parent_channels.synthesis: The repeated scene signature bridges P1, P2, and P3 by reversing control of orientation. Those who first choose to turn their side to warning meet a horizon-spanning appearance they misread and are finally made the presented object; voluntary avoidance becomes involuntary exposure.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole-surah: Funeral Concealment and Re-emergence
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Death stills the body, mourners lament, the body is folded into a shroud, and burial removes it from ordinary sight.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Death as stillness or sleep (`quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`); lamentation over the dead (`quranic:root_001633:B009/m01`); wrapping the dead in a shroud (`quranic:root_000468:B005/m01`); burial as concealment (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `يوحى إلي` (46:9), `أتعدانني أن أخرج` (46:17), `الجن والإنس` (46:18), `درجات` (46:19), `نفرا من الجن` (46:29), and `أن يحيي الموتى` (46:33).
parent_channels.synthesis: The funeral sequence usefully pressures the objection in 46:17: disappearance after prior generations is the result of stilling, wrapping, and concealment, not evidence of annihilation. It materializes the sequence that 46:33 claims divine power to reverse when it affirms revival of the dead.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole-surah: Cast Lots and the Displaced Oracle
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A practitioner keeps gaming or divinatory arrows in a container, casts them from the hand, strikes pebbles or draws lines for an answer, and expects a jinn familiar to disclose what is hidden.
parent_channels.active_motifs: A container holding gaming arrows or lots (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); lots or arrows cast from the hand (`quranic:root_001192:B004/m01`); divination by pebbles and traced lines (`quranic:root_000932:B004/m01`); a jinn familiar that purports to reveal divination (`quranic:root_000531:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `ائتوني بكتاب من قبل هذا أو أثارة من علم` and `أرأيتم` (46:4), `إذ تفيضون فيه` (46:8), `ربنا الله` (46:13), `إنما العلم عند الله` (46:23), `فلما رأوه عارضا` (46:24), `نفرا من الجن يستمعون القرآن` (46:29), and `طريق مستقيم` (46:30).
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene usefully pressures the surah's primary epistemology: book, attested knowledge, and revealed warning displace lots, pebble-lines, and a claimed spirit informant as routes to the unseen. P3 completes the reversal by presenting jinn not as oracles dispensing secret signs but as disciplined hearers of a revealed book.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole-surah: Contract, Dower, Procession, and Household
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A marriage is contracted, a dower establishes reciprocal obligation, the bride is conducted to her spouse, the couple enters a prepared household, and marriage supplies a protected social state.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Contracting a marriage (`quranic:root_001444:B004/m01`); a woman's dower (`quranic:root_000852:B007/m01`); a bride conducted to her spouse (`quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`); entering marriage and its bridal shelter (`quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`); marriage as protective sufficiency (`quranic:root_001110:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `إن كنتم صادقين` (46:4), `تملكون لي من الله شيئا` (46:8), `شاهد من بني إسرائيل` (46:10), `يهدي` (46:11), `وصينا الإنسان بوالديه`, `حملته أمه`, and `أصلح لي في ذريتي` (46:15), `قال لوالديه` (46:17), `فما أغنى عنهم` (46:26), and `يهدي إلى الحق` (46:30).
parent_channels.synthesis: The complete household-forming rite materializes the social prehistory of 46:15-17. Filial obligation follows a prior chain of contract, material commitment, public transfer, cohabitation, and protection, so the child's refusal ruptures an inherited structure of reciprocal care rather than an isolated biological relation.

parent_channels.name: S9. P1 -> P2 -> P3: A Charm That Claims to Turn the Heart
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A charm-maker faces one bead toward its intended subject, spaces beads among pearls, activates a binding spell, and claims that the finished device can seize attention or redirect desire.
parent_channels.active_motifs: A facing bead used by a charm-maker (`quranic:root_001198:B016/m01`); spacer beads set between pearls (`quranic:root_001159:B012/m01`); a spell or bead that binds (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); a bead claimed to turn the heart (`quranic:root_000860:B009/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `ائتوني بكتاب من قبل هذا` (P1, 46:4), `هذا سحر مبين` (P1, 46:7), `فصاله ثلاثون شهرا` (P2, 46:15), `لتأفكنا عن آلهتنا` (P2, 46:22), `مستقبل أوديتهم` (P2, 46:24), `صرفنا الآيات` (P3, 46:27), `اتخذوا من دون الله قربانا آلهة` (P3, 46:28), and `صرفنا إليك نفرا من الجن` (P3, 46:29).
parent_channels.synthesis: The assembled charm materializes what the accusation of magic would entail: a concealed device claiming to bind perception and turn a heart. That concrete mechanism pressures the charge in P1 and P2, because the surah instead presents public signs, articulated warning, and accountable response; P3 relocates effective direction from a claimed bead to God's turning of signs and listeners.
